SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```swift title="Swift"
import Crawlberg

let engineConfig = try crawlConfigFromJson("{\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"ssrf\":{\"allowlist\":[{\"type\":\"cidr\",\"value\":\"127.0.0.0/8\"}],\"deny_private\":true,\"max_redirects\":5},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}")
let engineObj = try createEngine(config: engineConfig)
let url = "https://example.com"
let result = try await Crawlberg.scrape(engine: engineObj, url: url)
print(result)
```
